value.name: dual_momentum
value.rationale: The strategy exploits time‑series momentum on two horizons: a medium‑term (≈60 bars) and a long‑term (≈250 bars) average of log returns. When the shorter‑horizon momentum exceeds the longer‑horizon momentum the market is in a persistent trend, so we stay long; otherwise we stay short. Because both windows are long, the signal changes only when the underlying trend truly shifts, yielding low turnover (well below the 7× equity per year limit) while still generating dozens of trades over a multi‑year history. This dual‑momentum concept is distinct from the single‑window cross‑over or mean‑reversion ideas that have already been tested.
